liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **High Time** (2 reviews): Singled out as a definite highlight of the first set; Praised as a great version [13][15]
- **Cold Rain and Snow** (1 review): Reviewer hears Jerry enjoying every minute of the opener, which leads into a sweet Race is On [13]
- **They Love Each Other** (1 review): Clouds looked wonderful during Jerry's solo on this song [10]
- **C.C. Rider** (1 review): Upbeat performance, with Bobby high in the mix strumming along and Phil dropping bombs [13]
- **Sugar Magnolia** (1 review): Reviewer likes the end of the song, where Phil drops bombs [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **The Race is On**: back after 318 archived shows (1660 days) [21]
- **Stage Annoucement**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [21]

## The recordings

- **gd86-05-03.beyer.cronk.9626.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 130 min; rated 1.67/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Beyer cassette-sourced copy has lots of high-end modulation and hiss, as if the cassette was warped before transfer; Reviewer says digital noise reduction on this copy ruined the recording, making it barely listenable [11][16]
- **gd1986-05-03.sbd.miller.81516.flac16**: soundboard; 17 songs; 127 min; rated 3.57/5 by 14 [2]
- **gd1986-05-03.156456.nak300.davis.holbrook.flac2448**: source not stated; 18 songs; 130 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd86-05-03.sbd.hinko.18375.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 17 songs; 126 min; rated 4.62/5 by 16 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer describes the soundboard as having super sound quality; Reviewer says Phil is clear and true in the mix, with everyone balanced equally [9][15]

## Around the show

- After the closing number, Phil said Jerry's and Bob's guitars were broken and his mind was blown, so there was no encore [9]
- A light sprinkle of rain fell early on, followed by striking cloud formations during Jerry's solo [10]
- Band was playful, Garcia smiled and gestured to the crowd, and there was plenty of dance room near the stage [10]
- Reviewer was running with three friends toward the entrance as the band started The Race Is On [20]
- Reviewer says another posting of this show is much clearer than the Beyer version [12]
- Reviewer says 1986 wasn't the Dead's best year, but they had a fine night here [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd86-05-03.beyer.cronk.9626.sbeok.shnf**: source: Beyer M88s>PCM>metal cass>CDR [1]. Also: Recorded with Beyer M88 microphones to PCM, then metal cassette, then CDR; via Drew Berry; seeded by Jimmy Cronk [1]
- **gd1986-05-03.sbd.miller.81516.flac16**: taped by Thanks to Paul Scotton and Joani Walker for the Cassettes; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5/TDK MA-R90) D [2]
- **gd1986-05-03.156456.nak300.davis.holbrook.flac2448**: taped by Executive Crew; Kenny Davis, Mike Davis, Tom Pinney, John Goode; transferred by Kyle Holbrook; source: Source: 1GEN AUDCA 2.5% speed correction each set Microphones: Nakamichi 300/CP4 shotgun capsules Recorder: Sony TC-D5M| Maxell MX 90's no Dolby (1st in line)… [3]. Also: Nakamichi 300 audience recording; uploader suspects it may match an earlier first-set mic master and offers the second set [3]
- **gd86-05-03.sbd.hinko.18375.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > MC > C > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN via Darryl Hinko [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead 30 Trips Around The Sun 1986 Cal Expo Sacramento CA 5/3/86 | #4634739427](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-30-trips-around-sun-4634739427) [22]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 5/3/86 Cal Expo Amphitheatr…](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27295846041/) [23]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27295846041/) [24]
